# vendor parts

Bought-part models that `scripts/concept_v33.py` imports (override the folder with `REAL=<dir>`).

| file | part | from |
|---|---|---|
| `motor.step` | Palm Beach Bots D2822 1100KV | the vendor's published model |
| `switch.step` | Fingertech mini power switch | the vendor's published model |

These are the vendors' models, kept so the generator runs from a clean checkout; they are not covered by the repo's licence.
